question: Among customers who use EUR as their currency, identify the one who made the highest single transaction (by Price) on '2012-08-25', and compute their year-over-year gas consumption decrease rate from 2012 to 2013.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
      AND t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-25'
    ORDER BY t.XCL_018 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth y
    INNER JOIN top_customer tc ON y.XCL_019 = tc.XCL_001
)
SELECT 
    CAST((cons_2012 - cons_2013) AS REAL) / cons_2012 AS decrease_rate
FROM consumption;

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
      AND t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-25'
    ORDER BY t.XCL_018 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth y
    INNER JOIN top_customer tc ON y.XCL_019 = tc.XCL_001
)
SELECT 
    CAST((cons_2012 - cons_2013) AS REAL) / cons_2012 AS decrease_rate
FROM consumption;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
      AND t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-25'
    ORDER BY t.XCL_018 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth y
    INNER JOIN top_customer tc ON y.XCL_019 = tc.XCL_001
)
SELECT 
    CAST((cons_2012 - cons_2013) AS REAL) / cons_2012 AS decrease_rate
FROM consumption;

WITH eur_customers AS (
    SELECT XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM customers
    WHERE XCL_003 = 'EUR'
),
top_transaction AS (
    SELECT t.XCL_013 AS customer_id, t.XCL_018 AS price
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN eur_customers ec ON t.XCL_013 = ec.customer_id
    WHERE t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-25'
    ORDER BY t.XCL_018 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        ym.XCL_020 AS year_month,
        ym.XCL_021 AS consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE ym.XCL_020 IN ('2012', '2013')
)
SELECT 
    (c2012.consumption - c2013.consumption) / c2012.consumption AS decrease_rate
FROM top_transaction tt
JOIN consumption c2012 ON c2012.year_month = '2012'
JOIN consumption c2013 ON c2013.year_month = '2013'
